features.title: Folk-magic martial
features.text: Combine weapon attacks with esoterica and supernatural implements. Implement choices can emphasize defense, healing, knowledge or other specialized tricks.

features.title: Exploit Vulnerability
features.text: Use esoteric knowledge to exploit an existing weakness or create a personal antithesis. Manage your implements and setup actions to keep pressure on the right foe.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4.5 → 4–4.5. Exploiting weaknesses and implement empowerment support strong weapon damage.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5–4. Amulet, chalice and other implement choices alter personal resilience.
ratings.support: 3 → 2–4.5. Implements may emphasize healing, protection or party bonuses instead of personal offense.
ratings.utility: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Esoteric knowledge and implement choices provide specialized information and exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Manage vulnerability setup, implements and hand requirements.
